items.title: Mona Hinton interviewed by Milt Fillius and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: Ben stayed at our house on occasion... I think I had a great influence on Ben... I sat him down one day and explained to him

ctx.x: That’s wonderful. We let’s see, did you have favorite musicians? You must have. I know that Ben Webster was one that’s held in high regard by your husband anyway.
Yeah, well Ben was one of them. I did have favorites.
Tell us who the favorites were.
